summary: 6-fold selectivity over 5-HT2B and 49-fold selectivity over 5-HT2C. It has a 5-HT2A Ki of 680 nM and an EC50 of 41 nM. (R)-69 is a biased agonist selective for activation of the Gq coupled signalling pathway, with much weaker activation of the β-arrestin 2 coupled pathway. In animal studies it produces antidepressant-like activity but without producing the head-twitch response associated with psychedelic effects.

pharmacology.text: (R)-69 (3IQ) is a drug of the tetrahydropyridinylpyrrolopyridine family related to the psychedelic tryptamines which acts as a 5-HT2A receptor agonist, with 4.6-fold selectivity over 5-HT2B and 49-fold selectivity over 5-HT2C. (R)-69 is a biased agonist selective for activation of the Gq coupled signalling pathway, with much weaker activation of the β-arrestin 2 coupled pathway.

summaryZh: -69也稱為3IQ是一種含氮有機化合物，分子式C13H15N3，屬於色胺的類似物，由布萊恩·L·羅斯及其同事在2022年為5-HT2A受體的激動劑研發，可作為迷幻藥物。
summaryZhHans: -69也称为3IQ是一种含氮有机化合物，分子式C13H15N3，属于色胺的类似物，由布莱恩·L·罗斯及其同事在2022年为5-HT2A受体的激动剂研发，可作为迷幻药物。

uses.en: It is a research compound, studied as a possible antidepressant that acts on the 5-HT2A receptor without causing hallucinations in animals.
uses.zh: 它是研究用化合物，被當作可能的抗憂鬱藥來研究，作用於5-HT2A受體，而在動物身上不引起幻覺。
uses.zhHans: 它是研究用化合物，被当作可能的抗忧郁药来研究，作用于5-HT2A受体，而在动物身上不引起幻觉。

fact.en: Its bare number comes from a research paper, where compounds are numbered rather than named. It is a biased agonist: it switches on only part of what the 5-HT2A receptor normally does.
fact.zh: 它這個光禿禿的編號來自一篇研究論文，論文中的化合物只有編號而沒有名字。它是一種偏向性促效劑：只活化5-HT2A受體正常功能中的一部分。
fact.zhHans: 它这个光秃秃的编号来自一篇研究论文，论文中的化合物只有编号而没有名字。它是一种偏向性促效剂：只活化5-HT2A受体正常功能中的一部分。
